verdict.rationale: Evidence never directly states Firstbase files an EIN application for founders; it only implies EIN status indirectly (e.g., letting non-incorporation users manually enter an EIN, or opening a bank account 'without an EIN'), suggesting EIN acquisition is bundled into incorporation but not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit first-party claim describing EIN application/filing as part of the incorporation flow, and any independent/community confirmation that Firstbase obtains the EIN on the founder's behalf.
